intent.name: Todos with tags
audience: one person keeping their own list
summary: A list of things you mean to do, each of which you can tag with a word.
It exists so nothing you meant to do gets forgotten, and so you can see which todos belong together.
You add a todo, tag it, take a tag off, and deleting a todo takes its tags with it.
success: You can see which todos belong together

understanding.ask: A todo list where I can tag todos. Deleting a todo should take its tags too.
said: A todo list where I can tag todos.
Deleting a todo should take its tags too.

assumed.text: a todo can carry several tags, each any word
deleting a todo removes only its own tags

concepts.purpose: You keep a list of things to do and tick them off
You tag a todo with a word to group it with others
